subject: Geopolitics
title: Strategic Petroleum Reserves
description: A micro-lesson that makes Strategic Petroleum Reserves usable.

hook.text: The US stores 400 million barrels of oil in salt caverns along the Gulf Coast. Insurance against an energy crisis.

buildup.text: After the 1973 oil shock, major importers built strategic reserves. A buffer to survive supply disruptions.

discovery.text: The US released reserves in 2022 to cool prices during the Russia-Ukraine war. It was the largest release ever.

twist.text: Reserves buy time but not solutions. They run out eventually. The real fix requires diverse, stable supply chains.

climax.text: Strategic reserves are a safety net, not a strategy. They smooth crises but can't prevent them.

punchline.text: Store enough oil to survive a crisis. Not to avoid one.

quiz.question: Why are strategic petroleum reserves limited as a solution?
options: They are too expensive to maintain
They buy time but run out without diverse supply chains
